_prompt: Read the following paper and list its limitations.
_generated_by: Claude (Opus 5), single call, no agents, no RAG, no judge, no feedback.

limitations.statement: The models are undertrained relative to the autoregressive baselines they are compared against, and the authors acknowledge more training tokens would help.
DiffuLLaMA underperforms LLaMA2, the model it was adapted from, which weakens the case for adaptation.
Evaluation is limited to a fixed set of benchmarks and may not generalize to other tasks or domains.
The approach is only demonstrated on two model families (GPT2 and LLaMA2), so generalizability to other architectures is unclear.
Instruction tuning is not performed, which the authors note limits the model's ability to follow prompts such as chain-of-thought.
The infilling comparison may be unfair to autoregressive baselines since suffix information is withheld.
Computational cost of the adaptation procedure is high, requiring substantial GPU resources.
The paper does not report error bars or multiple random seeds.
Scaling beyond 7B parameters is not explored.
There may be dataset bias from the web-scraped training corpus.
